protocol.models: ABBA blocks; 3 warmups and 9 unique measured requests per input size per block; state cache and persistent pack cache disabled; loading excluded; separate unprofiled wall and instrumented GPU timing; 18 samples per build and size
protocol.visibility: All targets hidden in default context; table models reuse one owned target per model, closed after the model; additional Kev-9B follow-up uses one fresh owned target per wall/profile block or decision replay. Current runner defaults to fresh targets. No browser launch or close call.
protocol.comparisonRule: Claim speedup only if both builds' block median ranges are <=10%, pooled median reduction >=5%, and block range separation >=5%; predefined screening rule, not a confidence interval.
protocol.regression: 36 authored cases x 3 option orders x 11 models per build; not independent held-out accuracy
protocol.cohort: Ten complete follow-up model comparisons plus the initial same-build Gemma E4B comparison. E4B repeat downloads did not complete and were canceled before inference; its row is explicitly labeled as the initial capture. Interrupted Bruv-0.8B records were replaced in full. No incomplete inference or download attempt is used as measurement evidence.
protocol.reporting: Table reports current arithmetic mean wall latency and separately instrumented median GPU time. Gemma E4B uses its initial same-build capture; the other ten rows use follow-up measurements. No cross-model speedup or held-out accuracy claim.
